thread:
rachel (People Ops): Idea  run a week-long "Recognition Roadshow" across our three offices: quick pop-ups, coffee cards, and a tiny badge for winners. Want to align logistics + tax/contractor rules. Thoughts?

sophia (People Ops): Love it. Short visits (30-60 min) per office, staffed by 2 People Ops + 1 volunteer. Keep awards modest (sticker + $25 card) to avoid payroll complexity.

dave (Payroll): FYI: anything >= $600 is taxable and must go through payroll. <$600 still needs tracking for records. Contractor treatment: contractors >90 days OK for swag, but monetary awards require vendor routing.

luis (Office Ops): We can reserve the lobby table in SF, the mezzanine in NY, and the cafe corner in LON. Need delivery windows for swag. Preferred dates?

tara (Design): I'll do a small badge die-cut and a 4x6 postcard that doubles as a certificate. Can print 300 badges by Thu if approved.

mike (Eng): Volunteer to help at SF Friday noon slot. Also can cover quick photos.

rachel (People Ops): Great. Budget ask: estimate $18/kit (card + sticker + badge + envelope) + shipping for remote. For 240 onsite + 20 remote ~ $4,400. Can we cap to $3,000 and trim?

dave (Payroll): $3k is fine, but we need GL code and expense tracker note. Also require recipient list export for audit.

people-bot: Quick export: 260 eligible recipients across offices; 18 remote. Link: https://go.example.com/roadshow-export. Marked contractors: 12.

sophia (People Ops): Action: People Ops to filter contractors and mark who gets swag vs monetary. We'll convert some monetary awards into gift cards to stay under payroll thresholds.

luis (Office Ops): Shipping windows: we can accept deliveries Wed morning for each site. Volunteers can pack Wed afternoon. I can host a 2-5pm packing shift at SF mailroom.

tara (Design): I'll upload print proofs by Tue EOD. Want badge color options: coral or midnight? Coral reads fun, midnight looks premium.

mike (Eng): Coral seems friendlier.

dave (Payroll): Also add tax notice in the claim form: "If total awards exceed IRS threshold, tax paperwork may apply." Legal cleared the wording.

rachel (People Ops): Okay plan: 1) Finalize counts Tue. 2) Tara upload art Tue EOD. 3) People Ops vet contractors Tue. 4) Dave to confirm GL code + upload instructions. 5) Luis to confirm packing space + sign-up. 6) Volunteers sign up by Wed noon.

people-bot: Reminder set: finalize_counts -> 2026-05-05T12:00:00-07:00

sophia (People Ops): Quick Q: public shoutouts? We can do opt-in photo wall + delayed announcement in #general the following week.

mike (Eng): Happy to help with photo ops, but all opt-in please.

luis (Office Ops): Security asked for a one-pager on camera usage for the roadshow. I'll draft and post here.

rachel (People Ops): Thanks all  I'll post the volunteer sheet and the recipient-masking packing view Tue AM. Closing for now. :sparkles:
